levels.title: PRE-A0 — Literacy and first classroom English

units.title: Listening to sounds and beginning phonics

lessons.title: Recognize the alphabet
lessons.scenario: A a, B b, C c, D d. Say the names; point to the matching forms. Avoid introducing all letter sounds at once.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Recognize the alphabet”?
flashcards.answer: correctly identify 20/26 uppercase letters in a mixed set and match at least 18 to their lowercase forms.

assessment: record each correct response; target is 20/26 identification and 18/26 matching. The answer is the identical letter in the other case, not a letter that merely looks similar.

lessons.title: Match uppercase and lowercase
lessons.scenario: match 24/26 case pairs without relying on alphabet order.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Match uppercase and lowercase”?
flashcards.answer: match 24/26 case pairs without relying on alphabet order.

assessment: 24/26 pairs correct in two shuffled rounds. If not, practice only the missed pairs and retest with cards in a different order.

lessons.title: Say letter names; do not confuse names with sounds
lessons.scenario: name 20/26 shown letters and select the spoken letter name when it is said aloud.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Say letter names; do not confuse names with sounds”?
flashcards.answer: name 20/26 shown letters and select the spoken letter name when it is said aloud.

assessment: 8/10 mixed name-versus-sound prompts correct. Repeat using different taught letters if missed.

lessons.title: Write recognizable letter forms
lessons.scenario: form at least 20 lowercase and 20 uppercase letters so a reader can identify them.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Write recognizable letter forms”?
flashcards.answer: form at least 20 lowercase and 20 uppercase letters so a reader can identify them.

assessment: teacher identifies at least 20/26 uppercase and lowercase attempts without being told which letter was intended.

lessons.title: Vowels, consonants, and speech sounds
lessons.scenario: identify the five vowel letters and classify the other 21 letters as consonant letters; identify the first sound in 4/5 taught words.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Vowels, consonants, and speech sounds”?
flashcards.answer: identify the five vowel letters and classify the other 21 letters as consonant letters; identify the first sound in 4/5 taught words.

assessment: 5/5 vowel-letter identification and 4/5 initial sounds. If letter categories are secure but sound responses are weak, keep the categories and reteach listening separately.

lessons.title: Hear and find first, middle, and last sounds
lessons.scenario: identify the first and last sounds in 4/5 familiar words and the short vowel sound in 3/4 spoken CVC words.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Hear and find first, middle, and last sounds”?
flashcards.answer: identify the first and last sounds in 4/5 familiar words and the short vowel sound in 3/4 spoken CVC words.

assessment: at least 4/5 initial/final responses and 3/4 vowel-pattern matches. If spelling is not yet known, assess oral identification with picture cards.

lessons.title: Contrast sounds without guessing from letter names
lessons.scenario: distinguish at least 4/5 teacher-spoken contrasts from the taught set, using picture or word cards.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Contrast sounds without guessing from letter names”?
flashcards.answer: distinguish at least 4/5 teacher-spoken contrasts from the taught set, using picture or word cards.

assessment: 4/5 selections across the pairs. If not met, use one contrast at a time, slow the model slightly, and retest with order changed. Do not tell the learner that their accent is wrong.

lessons.title: Short-vowel CVC patterns
lessons.scenario: blend and read 8/10 taught CVC words with short a, e, i, o, u.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Short-vowel CVC patterns”?
flashcards.answer: blend and read 8/10 taught CVC words with short a, e, i, o, u.

assessment: 8/10 correctly blended, including one example from each taught vowel set over the lesson sequence. If missed, sort by vowel and blend three words from the weak group before reassessment.

lessons.title: Blend, segment, and change one sound
lessons.scenario: read 8/10 taught CVC words and spell 4/5 from oral dictation using sound-to-letter mapping.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Blend, segment, and change one sound”?
flashcards.answer: read 8/10 taught CVC words and spell 4/5 from oral dictation using sound-to-letter mapping.

assessment: 8/10 reading and 4/5 spelling. Remediate only the missed position (initial, middle, final) with new examples such as pin/pan or map/mat.

lessons.title: Word families, rhyme, and syllables
lessons.scenario: identify a rhyming word for 4/5 spoken prompts and clap the syllables in 4/5 familiar words.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Word families, rhyme, and syllables”?
flashcards.answer: identify a rhyming word for 4/5 spoken prompts and clap the syllables in 4/5 familiar words.

assessment: 4/5 rhymes and 4/5 syllable counts. For a missed item, speak it naturally, tap beats, and repeat without written prompts.

lessons.title: Common consonant teams: `sh`, `ch`, `th`, `ck`
lessons.scenario: recognize sh, ch, and ck in taught words and decode 6/8 taught words.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Common consonant teams: `sh`, `ch`, `th`, `ck`”?
flashcards.answer: recognize sh, ch, and ck in taught words and decode 6/8 taught words.

assessment: identify 4 teams correctly and read 6/8 taught words with understandable sound sequence. Remediation: contrast one team against a known CVC word (sip/ship, chip/tip) with pictures.

lessons.title: Silent `e` as a useful pattern
lessons.scenario: distinguish four taught short-vowel/e word pairs by listening and match each written word to its spoken form.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Silent `e` as a useful pattern”?
flashcards.answer: distinguish four taught short-vowel/e word pairs by listening and match each written word to its spoken form.

assessment: 7/8 correct. If not, return to one pair at a time and use clear picture meanings; do not teach a universal “vowel says its name” rule.

lessons.title: Copy letters, labels, and word spaces
lessons.scenario: copy 8/10 familiar labels legibly and identify the word boundary in 4/5 short phrases.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Copy letters, labels, and word spaces”?
flashcards.answer: copy 8/10 familiar labels legibly and identify the word boundary in 4/5 short phrases.

assessment: 8/10 labels recognized by a second reader; 4/5 boundaries marked. If handwriting obscures spelling, allow letter cards or oral spelling to separate knowledge from motor control.

lessons.title: Spell and retrieve familiar words
lessons.scenario: spell 8/10 familiar words from picture, oral cue, or real object.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Spell and retrieve familiar words”?
flashcards.answer: spell 8/10 familiar words from picture, oral cue, or real object.

assessment: 8/10. For errors, sort into first sound, vowel pattern, final sound, or remembered spelling; practice that type and retest with a parallel word.

lessons.title: Read familiar signs and instructions
lessons.scenario: read and follow 4/5 familiar printed one-step instructions, follow 4/5 spoken instructions, and match 4/5 classroom labels to objects.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Read familiar signs and instructions”?
flashcards.answer: read and follow 4/5 familiar printed one-step instructions, follow 4/5 spoken instructions, and match 4/5 classroom labels to objects.

assessment: 4/5 printed instructions, 4/5 spoken instructions, 4/5 labels, and 2/2 text questions. Score reading, listening, and comprehension separately. If spoken comprehension fails, repeat with familiar words at a natural but slower pace; if printed reading fails, rehearse the phrase-to-action link, then test new printed commands.

lessons.title: Greetings and names
lessons.scenario: complete a two-turn greeting and state a name in an understandable phrase.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Greetings and names”?
flashcards.answer: complete a two-turn greeting and state a name in an understandable phrase.

assessment: learner initiates a greeting, says a name, and responds once without copying a written script. If anxious, rehearse with the teacher, then repeat with a partner.

lessons.title: Sounds, words, and classroom response
lessons.scenario: match cat, map, sun, pen to pictures; mark the first and last letter; read left to right. Then follow the spoken commands below.

flashcards.question: Which begins with the sound /s/?
flashcards.answer: cat; sun

flashcards.question: What was the final instruction?
flashcards.answer: cat; M; sit down

assessment: Which animal was mentioned? Which letter should be written? What was the final instruction?

correctly identify 8 of 10 mixed-case letters, read 3 of 4 CVC words, and respond to 4 of 5 commands. If not, reteach letter-name/sound distinction and blend two-word sets before retrying with different items.

lessons.title: Review and learner self-check
lessons.scenario: retrieve one letter, one sound, one word, one instruction, and one greeting without a model.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Review and learner self-check”?
flashcards.answer: retrieve one letter, one sound, one word, one instruction, and one greeting without a model.

lessons.title: Integrated sound, word, and classroom check
lessons.scenario: use taught letters, decode taught words, understand instructions, and exchange names.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Integrated sound, word, and classroom check”?
flashcards.answer: use taught letters, decode taught words, understand instructions, and exchange names.

units.title: Clock time, daily routines, and present simple

lessons.title: Subject pronouns and `be`
lessons.scenario: complete 8/10 sentence prompts with the correct subject pronoun and present be.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Subject pronouns and `be`”?
flashcards.answer: complete 8/10 sentence prompts with the correct subject pronoun and present be.

assessment: 8/10 correct in a new mixed set; include at least two different be forms.

lessons.title: Affirmative, negative, and `be` questions
lessons.scenario: turn 4/5 statements into accurate negatives and 4/5 into appropriate be questions.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Affirmative, negative, and `be` questions”?
flashcards.answer: turn 4/5 statements into accurate negatives and 4/5 into appropriate be questions.

assessment: 8/10 transformations with correct order and be.

lessons.title: Numbers, age, and spelling personal details
lessons.scenario: identify, say, and write 18/20 numbers from 1–20 and the taught tens; state age using a complete phrase.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Numbers, age, and spelling personal details”?
flashcards.answer: identify, say, and write 18/20 numbers from 1–20 and the taught tens; state age using a complete phrase.

assessment: 18/20 number recognition/writing including at least three teen/tens contrasts.

lessons.title: A simple personal introduction
lessons.scenario: “My name is Lina. I am nineteen and I live in Rabat. I have one brother. My brother is a student.”

flashcards.question: What is her brother?
flashcards.answer: Rabat; one; a student

flashcards.question: How many sisters does he have?
flashcards.answer: twenty; Tunis; two

assessment: at least 4/5 profile details conveyed correctly; 4 sentences use be/have accurately; question uses appropriate word order. Correct errors by sorting examples into be questions and do questions.

lessons.title: Days, months, dates, and birthdays
lessons.scenario: sequence days and months, understand 4/5 read dates, and say or write a personal date using an appropriate preposition.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Days, months, dates, and birthdays”?
flashcards.answer: sequence days and months, understand 4/5 read dates, and say or write a personal date using an appropriate preposition.

assessment: correctly sequence 6/7 days and 10/12 months (two rounds); 4/5 date/preposition items.

lessons.title: Family and basic plural nouns
lessons.scenario: identify 10 family words and form the plural of 8/10 taught regular nouns.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Family and basic plural nouns”?
flashcards.answer: identify 10 family words and form the plural of 8/10 taught regular nouns.

assessment: 8/10 plural forms and 8/10 picture-word matches.

lessons.title: `a/an`, `the`, and familiar objects
lessons.scenario: I have an apple. The apple is red.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “`a/an`, `the`, and familiar objects”?
flashcards.answer: choose a suitable article in 8/10 familiar noun phrases and identify when the object is already known.

assessment: 8/10 choices, judged by beginning sound and reference.

lessons.title: Basic adjectives and describing objects
lessons.scenario: produce five noun phrases with a correct simple adjective-before-noun order and matching be sentence.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Basic adjectives and describing objects”?
flashcards.answer: produce five noun phrases with a correct simple adjective-before-noun order and matching be sentence.

assessment: five phrases have adjective+noun order and no plural adjective ending.

lessons.title: Possessive adjectives, `have/has`, and `’s`
lessons.scenario: use four possessive adjectives and have/has in 8/10 descriptions; identify ownership with a name + 's.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Possessive adjectives, `have/has`, and `’s`”?
flashcards.answer: use four possessive adjectives and have/has in 8/10 descriptions; identify ownership with a name + 's.

assessment: 8/10 correct possessive/verb pairings and explain whose object is meant.

lessons.title: Read and describe a family/home profile
lessons.scenario: This is Hana's family. Her parents are at home. Hana has one brother and two sisters. Their home is small. It has a blue door and a big kitchen.

flashcards.question: What color is the door?
flashcards.answer: Hana's; two; at home; blue

assessment: 4/5 factual details; writing contains at least four understandable sentences, at least one possessive and one be/have form. If not, revisit the specific earlier lesson.

lessons.title: Clock time and time prepositions
lessons.scenario: identify 8/10 full-hour/half-hour clock times and choose at/on/in in 8/10 taught time phrases.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Clock time and time prepositions”?
flashcards.answer: identify 8/10 full-hour/half-hour clock times and choose at/on/in in 8/10 taught time phrases.

assessment: 8/10 clock matches and 4/5 prepositions.

lessons.title: Everyday verbs and present-simple statements
lessons.scenario: produce 6/7 short present-simple routine sentences with a subject and correct base/third-person verb form.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Everyday verbs and present-simple statements”?
flashcards.answer: produce 6/7 short present-simple routine sentences with a subject and correct base/third-person verb form.

assessment: 6/7 verbs appropriate for subject.

lessons.title: Frequency words and negative routines
lessons.scenario: place always, usually, sometimes, and never appropriately in 4/5 sentences and form 4/5 present-simple negatives.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Frequency words and negative routines”?
flashcards.answer: place always, usually, sometimes, and never appropriately in 4/5 sentences and form 4/5 present-simple negatives.

assessment: 4/5 adverb placements and 4/5 negatives.

lessons.title: `Do/does` questions and short answers
lessons.scenario: ask 4/5 present-simple questions with correct order and give a matching short answer.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “`Do/does` questions and short answers”?
flashcards.answer: ask 4/5 present-simple questions with correct order and give a matching short answer.

assessment: 4/5 question forms plus 4 matched short answers.

lessons.title: Read a simple timetable and report a routine
lessons.scenario: retrieve 4/5 timetable facts and give a short oral routine with three time phrases.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Read a simple timetable and report a routine”?
flashcards.answer: retrieve 4/5 timetable facts and give a short oral routine with three time phrases.

assessment: 4/5 facts and 4/5 sentences with correct subject/verb/time phrase.

lessons.title: Prepositions of place
lessons.scenario: describe 5/6 object locations using a taught preposition.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Prepositions of place”?
flashcards.answer: describe 5/6 object locations using a taught preposition.

assessment: 5/6 accurate descriptions and partner can reproduce 4/5 arrangements.

lessons.title: `there is/there are` and local places
lessons.scenario: describe a simple picture/map with 5/6 correct singular/plural there is/are statements and answer 3 location questions.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “`there is/there are` and local places”?
flashcards.answer: describe a simple picture/map with 5/6 correct singular/plural there is/are statements and answer 3 location questions.

assessment: 5/6 agreement and three understandable questions.

lessons.title: `can/can't` for ability and polite requests
lessons.scenario: express 3 abilities/inabilities and make 3 understandable requests using can.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “`can/can't` for ability and polite requests”?
flashcards.answer: express 3 abilities/inabilities and make 3 understandable requests using can.

assessment: 5/6 correct base-verb forms and requests include an understandable request plus polite marker where suitable.

lessons.title: Ask for help and give simple directions
lessons.scenario: complete a map-based exchange by asking where one place is and giving two-step directions.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Ask for help and give simple directions”?
flashcards.answer: complete a map-based exchange by asking where one place is and giving two-step directions.

lessons.title: Word order, capitals, full stops, and `and/but`
lessons.scenario: arrange 5/6 word sets into simple statements and punctuate 4/5 sentences appropriately.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Word order, capitals, full stops, and `and/but`”?
flashcards.answer: arrange 5/6 word sets into simple statements and punctuate 4/5 sentences appropriately.

assessment: 5/6 word orders and 4/5 capitalization/end marks.

lessons.title: Read a message and find the useful details
lessons.scenario: retrieve 4/5 literal details from a short familiar message and identify its practical purpose.

flashcards.question: What color is the book?
flashcards.answer: Lina; at the library; four o'clock; Lina's book; blue

assessment: 4/5 facts and practical purpose.

lessons.title: Write a short connected profile
lessons.scenario: My name is Huda. I am 20. I live in a small city. I have one brother. Our home is near a park. I study in the morning. I go to the library at four.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Write a short connected profile”?
flashcards.answer: write 6–8 connected sentences about self, family, home, or routine, including at least one be, one have/has, and two routine/location details.

lessons.title: Retrieval, diagnostic repair, and transition practice
lessons.scenario: retrieve at least one target from each unit and identify one personal review need.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Retrieval, diagnostic repair, and transition practice”?
flashcards.answer: retrieve at least one target from each unit and identify one personal review need.

assessment: complete resources/foundation-assessment.md diagnostic repair check, then final transition gate on a later day. Link results to the specific outcome/lesson; do not average a missed listening skill away with strong writing.

lessons.title: Ask and answer personal questions
lessons.scenario: ask and answer four personal questions using appropriate be or do forms.

flashcards.question: Where are you from?
flashcards.answer: I'm from Rabat

flashcards.question: Where do you work?
flashcards.answer: I work at a hotel

assessment: 4/4 questions have correct auxiliaries and the partner can report two answers.

lessons.title: Describe people and relationships
lessons.scenario: Nadia is from Tunis. She is a cook. Her husband works at a school. They have one child. Ask who is a cook and where her husband works.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Describe people and relationships”?
flashcards.answer: write and say five accurate sentences about two people using family/job words and be, have, and present-simple verbs.

assessment: five meaningful sentences; accurate subject-verb agreement in 4/5.

lessons.title: Give and check contact details
lessons.scenario: exchange fictional contact cards; listener reads back the number for confirmation.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Give and check contact details”?
flashcards.answer: understand and exchange a name, phone number, and email address, asking for repetition once when needed.

assessment: transcribe all name letters and at least 9/10 digits; accurately ask for clarification.

lessons.title: Describe a home and locate objects
lessons.scenario: partner A describes a room; partner B places four counters on a blank plan and asks one location question.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Describe a home and locate objects”?
flashcards.answer: describe a room in five sentences using there is/are and three place phrases.

assessment: at least 4/5 accurate is/are choices and three understandable location phrases.

lessons.title: Describe routines and frequency
lessons.scenario: describe a weekday routine in six sentences, placing frequency words correctly and using third-person -s in 4/5 target clauses.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Describe routines and frequency”?
flashcards.answer: describe a weekday routine in six sentences, placing frequency words correctly and using third-person -s in 4/5 target clauses.

assessment: six relevant sentences, 4/5 verb forms and 4/5 adverb positions.

lessons.title: A routine and a simple invitation
lessons.scenario: “Mina starts work at eight. She usually takes the bus, but today she is walking because the bus is late. She has lunch at noon.”

flashcards.question: Why is she walking today?
flashcards.answer: eight; the bus; the bus is late

flashcards.question: Why are they arriving earlier this week?
flashcards.answer: in a bookshop; nine; they are helping with a new display

assessment: answer 3/3 factual questions; produce a present-simple habit and a present-continuous “now/temporary” example; message includes all four required elements. If tense choice is unclear, sort five new statements into “usual” and “happening now”.

lessons.title: Name foods and express preferences
lessons.scenario: ask a partner Do you like ...? and record three answers; report one accurate fact.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Name foods and express preferences”?
flashcards.answer: name eight foods and state three preferences using like/don't like and a reason.

assessment: 8/10 food-picture matches and three understandable preference sentences.

lessons.title: Order politely and ask about prices
lessons.scenario: complete a café exchange with an item, quantity, price question, and confirmation.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Order politely and ask about prices”?
flashcards.answer: complete a café exchange with an item, quantity, price question, and confirmation.

assessment: complete four transaction moves, correctly use singular/plural price question.

lessons.title: Ask for quantities and complete a shopping list
lessons.scenario: For lunch, buy a loaf of bread, six eggs, some cheese, and two tomatoes. Ask what is bought and how many eggs.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Ask for quantities and complete a shopping list”?
flashcards.answer: understand a short shopping list and request at least four items using containers or quantities.

assessment: list has five suitable items, two quantities, and four successful exchange turns.

lessons.title: Read a simple timetable
lessons.scenario: retrieve five details from a weekly timetable and ask two schedule questions.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Read a simple timetable”?
flashcards.answer: retrieve five details from a weekly timetable and ask two schedule questions.

assessment: 4/5 facts and correct auxiliary in both questions.

lessons.title: Say what is happening now
lessons.scenario: contrast routine and current action in six spoken/written sentences, with correct be + -ing in 4/5 clauses.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Say what is happening now”?
flashcards.answer: contrast routine and current action in six spoken/written sentences, with correct be + -ing in 4/5 clauses.

assessment: classify 5/6 contexts and form 4/5 continuous clauses.

lessons.title: Write a short schedule message
lessons.scenario: write a 40–60-word schedule message with two activities, two times/days, and one question.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Write a short schedule message”?
flashcards.answer: write a 40–60-word schedule message with two activities, two times/days, and one question.

assessment: 40–60 words, required schedule details, readable sentence punctuation, and accurate forms in 4/5 clauses.

lessons.title: Ask for and follow directions
lessons.scenario: each learner gets a different start/destination card and gives directions without pointing.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Ask for and follow directions”?
flashcards.answer: ask where a place is and follow a two-step route on a simple map.

assessment: 4/5 routes followed accurately.

lessons.title: Ask for a simple service
lessons.scenario: complete a service exchange with a greeting, need, one information question, and a confirmation.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Ask for a simple service”?
flashcards.answer: complete a service exchange with a greeting, need, one information question, and a confirmation.

assessment: all four exchange moves; learner accurately repeats the key time/place.

lessons.title: Understand a public notice
lessons.scenario: CITY LIBRARY: Open Monday–Saturday, 9:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Closed Sunday. Please return books at the desk. New members: bring an ID card.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Understand a public notice”?
flashcards.answer: identify purpose and three details in a short familiar notice.

assessment: 4/4 details and one accurate purpose statement.

lessons.title: Talk about hobbies and preferences
lessons.scenario: ask and answer five questions about free-time activities and give one reason.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Talk about hobbies and preferences”?
flashcards.answer: ask and answer five questions about free-time activities and give one reason.

assessment: 4/5 questions well formed, one reason, and two correct reported facts.

lessons.title: Invite, accept, and decline politely
lessons.scenario: make an invitation, accept or decline, and agree on a day/time/place.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Invite, accept, and decline politely”?
flashcards.answer: make an invitation, accept or decline, and agree on a day/time/place.

assessment: include invitation, response, alternative/confirmation; partner can repeat the agreed plan.

lessons.title: Write and relay an invitation
lessons.scenario: Hi Lina, Would you like to see a film on Friday? It starts at six at the City Cinema. We can meet outside at 5:45. Let me know if you can come. — Noor

flashcards.question: What time does the learner get up?
flashcards.answer: How do they go to work

flashcards.question: What do they do at lunch?
flashcards.answer: What do they do in the evening

assessment: all five details present, 4/5 understandable sentences, relay preserves day/time/place.
What time does the learner get up?
How do they go to work?
What do they do at lunch?
What do they do in the evening?

lessons.title: Build a past-time account
lessons.scenario: tell a real or imagined account using these or six learner-created events.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Build a past-time account”?
flashcards.answer: tell a six-event weekend account using at least four accurate past forms and three sequence markers.

assessment: at least four accurate past forms and three sequence markers in logical order.

lessons.title: Add a reaction and a reason
lessons.scenario: On Sunday, I took my niece to the science museum. We saw a robot show and made a paper bridge. The museum was busy, but the staff were helpful. I enjoyed the visit because my niece asked many questions.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Add a reaction and a reason”?
flashcards.answer: write a 70–90-word account with an event, reaction, reason, and contrast.

assessment: 70–90 words, 3 accurate past verbs, one reason and one contrast, clear event order.

lessons.title: A past visit and a future arrangement
lessons.scenario: “On Saturday, Huda visited the old market with her cousin. They bought fruit and had lunch at a small café. Huda liked the market because it was lively, although it was crowded. She is going to return next month.”

flashcards.question: Why did she like the market?
flashcards.answer: her cousin; fruit; it was lively

flashcards.question: Why are they leaving home later today?
flashcards.answer: 10:30; yesterday; because the station is quieter in the morning

assessment: correctly answer all 3 content questions; use two past forms and a clearly marked intention; writing contains the three required features. Review irregular past forms in a fresh sentence if missed.

lessons.title: Plan a journey from a timetable
lessons.scenario: use a second timetable card to plan a trip; ask a partner two questions and repeat the answer to confirm.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Plan a journey from a timetable”?
flashcards.answer: retrieve four journey details and ask two accurate timetable questions.

assessment: 4/5 details, both questions understandable, no confusion of departure and arrival.

lessons.title: Explain a travel problem and request help
lessons.scenario: Platform 2 is closed. For trains to Hilltown, use platform 4. Ask staff if you need assistance. Which platform? 4. What is closed? Platform 2.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Explain a travel problem and request help”?
flashcards.answer: explain a travel problem and complete a four-turn help exchange, including one clarification.

assessment: problem, request, relevant question, accurate confirmation all present.

lessons.title: Compare accommodation and confirm a booking
lessons.scenario: compare two lodging options and confirm three booking details in a role-play.

flashcards.question: What is the goal of “Compare accommodation and confirm a booking”?
flashcards.answer: compare two lodging options and confirm three booking details in a role-play.

assessment: comparison accurate, all three details repeated, no invented amenities.

lessons.title: Describe symptoms and ask for help
lessons.scenario: use a fictional symptom card to explain problem and duration; partner asks one follow-up.

flashcards.question: I feel tired, but I don't have a fever.” Ask symptom, start, fever?
flashcards.answer: sore throat; yesterday; no

assessment: symptom, time, and effect conveyed; partner accurately repeats them.

lessons.title: Give simple advice and understand instructions
lessons.scenario: give two relevant suggestions and follow three short care instructions.
